name: com.clicndone.pdf/pdf-tools
title: Clic'n Done PDF
description: PDF to Word that keeps the layout, merge, split, compress, OCR, PDF/A and more

tools.name: pdf_to_word
tools.description: Turn your PDFs into editable Word documents that look just like the original: same fonts, margins, tables, columns and images. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 10 per file + 1 per page (at most 50 per file).

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

tools.name: merge_pdf
tools.description: Combine several PDFs into a single file, in the order you want, in a few seconds. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 5 per file.

files.description: Input files (.pdf), at least 2. Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Split a PDF into several: one page per file or the page ranges you choose. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 5 per file.

files.description: Input files (.pdf), exactly 1. Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

ranges.description: Page ranges. Page ranges, comma-separated: '1-3' are pages 1 to 3, '5' only page 5 and '8-' from page 8 to the end. Each range becomes its own PDF. Empty: one PDF per page.

tools.name: rotate_pdf
tools.description: Rotate the pages of your PDFs by 90, 180 or 270 degrees, all of them or only the ones you choose, and save them that way. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 10 per file.

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

ranges.description: Pages. Pages to rotate, as ranges ('1-3, 5, 8-'). Empty: all pages.

tools.name: compress_pdf
tools.description: Shrink your PDFs to send them by email or upload them to a form, at the quality you choose. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 10 per file.

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

level.description: Compression Values: 'baja' = Low (better quality); 'recomendada' = Recommended; 'extrema' = Extreme (smallest)

tools.name: pdf_to_jpg
tools.description: Turn every page of your PDFs into a JPG image, at the resolution you need. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 2 per page.

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

dpi.description: Resolution Values: '96' = 96 dpi (screen, light); '150' = 150 dpi; '300' = 300 dpi (print)

tools.name: word_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert Word (DOCX, DOC), OpenDocument (ODT) and RTF documents into PDFs ready to send or print. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 10 per file.

files.description: Input files (.doc, .docx, .odt, .rtf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

tools.name: ocr_pdf
tools.description: Recognise the text in your scanned PDFs so you can search, select and copy it, without changing how they look. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 5 per page.

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

tools.name: compare_pdf
tools.description: Upload two versions of a contract, report or tender, as PDF or Word, and we mark what was added and what was removed. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 2 per page.

files.description: Input files (.pdf, .doc, .docx, .odt, .rtf), exactly 2. Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

lang.description: Language. Language of the texts the tool adds. Values: 'es' = Spanish; 'en' = English

tools.name: redact_pdf
tools.description: Finds IDs, bank accounts, cards, phone numbers, emails, names and addresses and really redacts them: nothing is left under the black box. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 3 per page.

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

categories.description: What to redact Values: 'dni' = Spanish ID (DNI, NIE); 'iban' = Bank accounts (IBAN); 'tarjeta' = Cards; 'telefono' = Phone numbers; 'email' = Emails; 'nombre' = Names; 'direccion' = Addresses

terms.description: Other words or names, separated by commas. e.g. Ana Ruiz, Project Phoenix

mode.description: Result Values: 'tachar' = Redact them (permanent); 'marcar' = Just mark them, to review

lang.description: Language. Language of the texts the tool adds. Values: 'es' = Spanish; 'en' = English

tools.name: pdf_to_excel
tools.description: Turn the tables in a PDF into Excel, each in its own sheet and with numbers as numbers, ready to add up. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 5 per page.

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

content.description: What to put in Excel Values: 'tablas' = Just the tables, one sheet per table; 'todo' = All the text, one sheet per page

lang.description: Language. Language of the texts the tool adds. Values: 'es' = Spanish; 'en' = English

tools.name: jpg_to_pdf
tools.description: Put photos, scans and screenshots (JPG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP…) into a single PDF, in the order you want and without losing quality. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 1 per page.

files.description: Input files (.bmp, .gif, .jfif, .jpe, .jpeg, .jpg, .png, .tif, .tiff, .webp). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

size.description: Page size Values: 'a4' = A4; 'carta' = Letter; 'imagen' = Same as the image

margin.description: Margin Values: 'no' = No margin; 'pequeno' = Small; 'grande' = Large

tools.name: organize_pdf
tools.description: Reorder the pages of a PDF by dragging them, rotate them or delete the ones you don't need, with every page shown as a thumbnail. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 5 per file.

files.description: Input files (.pdf), exactly 1. Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

pages.description: New page order, comma-separated, pages numbered from 1, each with an optional ':angle' to rotate it (90, 180 or 270). Pages left out are removed and repeated ones are duplicated. Example: '3, 1:90, 2'.

tools.name: pdf_to_pdfa
tools.description: Convert your PDFs to PDF/A-2b, the long-term archiving format many registries and online government services ask for, without changing how they look. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 2 per page.

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

tools.name: add_page_numbers
tools.description: Number the pages of your PDFs: at the bottom or top, on one side or in the centre, and from the page and number you choose. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 5 per file.

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

position.description: Position Values: 'abajo-centro' = Bottom centre; 'abajo-derecha' = Bottom right; 'abajo-izquierda' = Bottom left; 'arriba-centro' = Top centre; 'arriba-derecha' = Top right; 'arriba-izquierda' = Top left

lang.description: Language. Language of the texts the tool adds. Values: 'es' = Spanish; 'en' = English

tools.name: watermark_pdf
tools.description: Add a text such as “CONFIDENTIAL” or “Copy for the bank” to every page of your PDFs, diagonally or repeated, in the colour and strength you want. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 5 per file.

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

layout.description: Layout Values: 'diagonal' = Diagonal; 'horizontal' = Horizontal; 'mosaico' = Repeated across the page

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Waits for a job started by another tool that was still running, and returns its download link when it is done.
